name: link_sessions
description: Lists the user's Claude Code sessions that are open right now with the tanka-link plugin: the project and branch each works on, whether it is waiting (listening) or busy with a turn, and its folder. Use it when the user asks what sessions they have open, or before link_send to get a session's number. It changes nothing and cannot open sessions. Returns one numbered line per session; the numbers are valid for link_send until the next list.
